blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Motorists in Samar and Southern Leyte are advised to expect changes in traffic movement as the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) implements a load restriction on one bridge and schedules temporary closures of another. The adjustments are meant to facilitate infrastructure works. The DPWH Samar 2nd District Engineering Office announced that Bical Bridge in Barangay San Pedro, Sta. Rita, Samar will be subject to a temporary load restriction starting Nov. 23, 2026, until further notice. Under the restriction, vehicles crossing the bridge must not exceed a maximum gross vehicle weight (GVW) of 15 metric tons. Heavy […]...
